📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-03-eda-consumer-amqp-stopped-publishing`
This is occurrence #53. Self-recovering AMQP publish-hits gap, benign shape (matches 51 prior occurrences).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `DevOps` (`@devops` / `#team-devops`) — inert text per Hard rule #13. (Ownership-by-Project row says "Integrations" but no active team by that name exists in ownership.md; KB entry itself frames this as an Integrations/DevOps joint concern.)
Playbook: 1) Confirm DD monitor 296641466 in No Data state. 2) ALWAYS check sibling P1 monitors first — 296632224 (Event ingest stopped), 296636101 (Kafka events stopped) — if both OK, core EDA pipeline is healthy. 3) Confirm service:eda_consumer status:error returns 0 in DD Logs. 4) If siblings also fire, escalate immediately (real EDA-stack outage). 5) Not actionable on a single occurrence — this entry exists so repeats are recognized quickly.
Open Jira: n/a

Source alerts (1 total, degraded mode — no Slack permalink available):
  • https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/296641466

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/296641466 (OK, recovered 2026-08-17T10:39:27Z)
  • Sibling P1 monitors (both OK throughout): https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/296632224, https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/296636101
  • DD metric: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.amqp.command.hits&exp_scope=service%3Aeda_consumer%2Cenv%3Aprod&exp_agg=sum&start=1786952367&end=1786963167 — publish-hits gapped ~44min (09:53–10:37Z), then resumed
  • DD logs (0 errors during gap): service:eda_consumer status:error, 09:53–10:39Z
  • Kibana: n/a — evidence_source is datadog_apm for this KB, not ES

📊 *weekly triage digest* — 2026-08-10 → 2026-08-17

*Volume:* 112 alerts triaged · 35 posted · 60 suppressed to digest (+17 false-alarms closed out separately — not posted, not part of the deferred pile)
⚠ `docs/actionable/2026-08-12.md` is missing — incident log shows 4 poll-cycles + 2 groups + 3 known-issue-recurrence classifications that day (3 KIR were posted to #triage-results per the message log), so triage ran but didn't commit the actionable file. Not a data-loss risk (message log + KB are intact), but worth a look.

*New this week:*
- `ki-2026-08-13-tables-fields-getfields-nullreference-emailsenders` — 8th distinct bug signature on monitor 299251404 (NullReferenceException in FieldController.GetFields, EmailSenders view), filed as defect
- `ki-2026-08-14-microservices-method-int-100s-timeout-cascade` — ~70s cross-service timeout cascade (preferences/tags/scheduler/authservice), posted live as an incident, not part of the suppressed pile
- `fa-2026-08-15-sommselection-bingbot-analytics-beacon-noise` — new false-alarm entry, bot-traffic pattern, closed out

*Aging:* all 9 entries that recurred this week are ≥30d since `first_seen` (KB has no fix_status-change timestamp, so this is a floor, not exact — actual last-change could be more recent). Two are worth a nudge because the status itself implies unfinished work, not a settled call:
- `ki-2026-07-03-eda-consumer-amqp-stopped-publishing` — still `escalated-for-review` at ~58d
- `ki-2026-05-24-runtime-core-rtc-p95-recurring` — still `investigating` at ~86d
Oldest by first_seen: `ki-2026-07-03-method-ui-grid-dropdown-performance-test-nodata` (~107d) — but its status (`confirmed-non-prod-noise`) reads as a settled decision, not a stalled one.

*Concentration:* top 3 = 37/47 = 78.7% of this week's suppressed occurrences — above Method's standing ~66% all-time figure. `gateway-microservices-timeout` + the `crm-amqp-consumer` family alone carry the bulk.

*Suppression ratio:* 60 suppressed vs 35 posted (63%) — steady vs last week's 88/54 (62%), gate behaving consistently, not trending toward too-quiet.

One thing most worth doing next week: `ki-2026-07-03-eda-consumer-amqp-stopped-publishing` has sat at `escalated-for-review` for 58 days across 53 occurrences — that's a decision nobody's made yet.
